failure.title: Invalid server rate-profile configuration was misclassified as client input
failure.note: The retained pre-fix security test and coverage configuration reproduce one failure after 15 passes: invalid load-profile activation returned the generic client-validation status rather than failing the server boundary closed.
failure.diagnosis: Server-environment parsing occurred inside the shared request guard, but its Zod failure escaped to a boundary that interpreted every Zod error as malformed request input. A valid request against invalid server policy therefore received HTTP 400 instead of a sanitized HTTP 500.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
